title: WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents

paragraphs.en: Interactive 3D worlds allow human players and agents to explore, interact with objects, and complete tasks in realistic simulated environments. Recent work has expanded their use in embodied AI, from navigation and manipulation to open-ended exploration ( Yang et al., 2024b ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Ye et al., 2025 ) . Yet a world can look convincing while still containing anomalies. For example, a chair may float above the floor, a solid wall may allow an agent to walk through it, or an object may disappear after the agent looks away. Recent works highlight such visual and physical defects, while others develop methods to improve object placement, collision handling, and physical consistency ( Yang et al., 2024a ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Jia & Chen, 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Taesiri et al., 2025 ) . Such anomalies matter wherever interactive worlds are used to study intelligent behavior. For example, an agent that succeeds at certain tasks by walking through a broken wall should not be seen as reliable in navigation. Checking these environments therefore requires more than inspecting how they look, since some defects become apparent only through interaction or repeated exploration in the environments. This raises a natural question: Can multimodal agents autonomously identify anomalies in a 3D world, i.e., perform world auditing ?
paragraphs.zh: 交互式三维世界允许人类玩家和智能体在逼真的模拟环境中探索、与物体互动并完成任务。 近期的研究已将其应用扩展到具身人工智能领域，涵盖导航、操作以及开放式探索（Yang et al., 2024b；Xie et al., 2025；Lee et al., 2025；Yang et al., 2025b；Ye et al., 2025）。 然而，一个世界即使存在异常，也可能看起来令人信服。 例如，一把椅子可能悬浮在地板上方，一堵实心墙可能允许智能体穿过它，或者某个物体在智能体移开视线后消失。 近期的研究指出了这类视觉和物理缺陷，而另一些研究则致力于改进物体放置、碰撞处理及物理一致性（Yang et al., 2024a；Zhou et al., 2026；Jia & Chen, 2025；Lin et al., 2025；Taesiri et al., 2025）。 只要交互式世界被用于研究智能行为，这类异常就至关重要。 例如，一个通过穿过破损墙壁来完成某些任务的智能体，不应被视为在导航方面可靠的智能体。 因此，检查这些环境需要做的不仅仅是观察其外观，因为有些缺陷只有通过互动或在环境中反复探索才能显现出来。 这引出了一个自然的问题：多模态智能体能否自主识别三维世界中的异常，即执行世界审计？

paragraphs.en: World auditing requires two skills: action , to navigate the 3D world and search for anomalies systematically and efficiently, and visual reasoning , to understand the scene and identify anomalies from observations. More importantly, these two skills are deeply coupled. The agent must search large spaces within a limited exploration budget while distinguishing real defects from unusual but valid appearances or behavior. An observation may reveal a possible anomaly without providing enough evidence to confirm it. The agent must then choose an action to further investigate and decide whether a real defect is present. Auditing therefore requires both skills to work together: visual reasoning guides what to test, and action provides further evidence for the diagnosis. For example, the fence in Figure 1 Missing Collision Anomaly appears to be a solid barrier, but its collision defect becomes apparent only through interaction. The agent must navigate toward the fence and attempt to cross it. Comparing views in the same direction before and after moving straight ahead by 3 m reveals that the agent passed through the fence without being blocked. This process connects visual reasoning and action: recognizing the barrier establishes an expectation about blocked movement, moving forward tests it, and the resulting observation provides evidence of the collision failure.
paragraphs.zh: 世界审计需要两种技能：行动，即导航三维世界并系统高效地搜索异常；以及视觉推理，即理解场景并从观察中识别异常。 更重要的是，这两种技能深度耦合。 智能体必须在有限的探索预算内搜索巨大的空间，同时区分真实缺陷与不寻常但有效的表象或行为。 一次观察可能揭示潜在的异常，但未必提供足够的证据来确认它。 此时，智能体必须选择一个行动以进一步调查，并判断是否存在真实缺陷。 因此，审计需要这两种技能协同工作：视觉推理指导测试对象，而行动则为诊断提供更多证据。 例如，图1“缺失碰撞异常”中的围栏看似是一道实体屏障，但只有通过互动才能发现其碰撞缺陷。 智能体必须导航至围栏处，并尝试穿过它。 比较向前移动3米前后同一方向的视角可以发现，智能体穿过了围栏而未受到阻挡。 这一过程将视觉推理与行动联系起来：识别屏障建立了对运动受阻的预期，向前移动则对此进行了测试，而最终观察结果提供了碰撞失败的证据。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks evaluate visual reasoning over fixed observations or interactive task completion ( Taesiri et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Majumdar et al., 2024 ) , while interactive anomaly search covers out-of-place objects ( Pardyl et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试评估的是基于固定观察结果的视觉推理能力或交互式任务完成能力（Taesiri 等，2025；Yang 等，2025a；Majumdar 等，2024），而交互式异常搜索则涵盖了不协调的物体（Pardyl 等，2025）。 对世界审计的全面评估仍未被充分探索：智能体必须采取行动收集证据并识别各种异常，包括那些仅通过交互或在不同视角和时间之间进行比较才能发现的异常。

paragraphs.en: To fill this gap, we introduce WorldAuditBench, comprising 213 anomaly tasks across 13 environments implemented in Unreal Engine and Three.js. As illustrated in Figure 1 , these environments cover indoor, city, historical, industrial, and natural settings. We organize anomalies into five families: static physics, interactive physics, spatial consistency, temporal consistency, and semantic consistency. Together, these families cover both visible defects and anomalies that require interaction or repeated observation to detect. Each task pairs an anomaly with its expected normal behavior, relevant scene context, and an evaluation rubric. To solve a task, the auditor explores the scene from a first-person perspective and submits a report describing the anomaly and supporting observations. Table 1 compares WorldAuditBench with prior benchmarks and simulation environments, highlighting its focus on interactive anomaly identification across diverse anomaly families.
paragraphs.zh: 为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 WorldAuditBench，它包含在 Unreal Engine 和 Three.js 中实现的 13 个环境中的 213 项异常任务。 如图 1 所示，这些环境涵盖了室内、城市、历史、工业和自然场景。 我们将异常分为五类：静态物理、交互物理、空间一致性、时间一致性和语义一致性。 这些类别共同覆盖了可见缺陷以及需要交互或反复观察才能检测到的异常。 每个任务都将一项异常与其预期的正常行为、相关场景上下文以及评估标准配对。 要完成一个任务，审计员需以第一人称视角探索场景，并提交一份描述该异常及支持性观察结果的报告。 表 1 比较了 WorldAuditBench 与先前的基准和模拟环境，突出了其在多样化异常类别中专注于交互式异常识别的特点。

paragraphs.en: To study how action and visual reasoning work together in world auditing, we evaluate two auditor setups: ➀ a single VLM agent auditor , which uses a single multimodal LLM to inspect observations, select actions, and report anomalies; and ➁ a two-stage VLA–VLM agent auditor , which uses a VLA model to explore the environment and then passes the resulting trajectory to a VLM for offline anomaly analysis. The key difference is whether anomaly analysis can guide exploration process: the VLM agent can adjust its actions to investigate suspected anomalies, while the two-stage auditor analyzes a fixed trajectory, resembling a conventional video QA setup.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究行动与视觉推理在环境审计中的协同作用，我们评估了两种审计智能体配置：➀ 单 VLM 智能体审计器，它使用单个多模态 LLM 来检查观察结果、选择行动并报告异常；以及 ➁ 两阶段 VLA–VLM 智能体审计器，它首先使用 VLA 模型探索环境，然后将生成的轨迹传递给 VLM 进行离线异常分析。 关键区别在于异常分析是否能够指导探索过程：VLM 智能体能够调整其行动以调查可疑的异常，而两阶段审计器则分析一条固定的轨迹，类似于传统的视频问答设置。

paragraphs.en: Across the 213 evaluation tasks, VLM agents achieve success rates of 28.2% to 42.3%, compared with 6.6% to 17.4% for two-stage VLA–VLM auditors . These results suggest that using observations to guide further exploration helps agents gather evidence to verify suspected defects. However, both approaches fall well below the human success rate of 83.4%, leaving a substantial gap in their ability to audit interactive worlds.
paragraphs.zh: 在 213 项评估任务中，VLM 智能体的成功率介于 28.2% 到 42.3% 之间，而两阶段 VLA–VLM 审计员的成功率则为 6.6% 到 17.4%。 这些结果表明，利用观察结果指导进一步探索有助于智能体收集证据以验证可疑缺陷。 然而，这两种方法的成功率都远低于人类 83.4% 的成功率，在审计交互式世界的能力方面仍存在巨大差距。

paragraphs.en: To better understand this gap, we evaluate five model backbones and conduct controlled ablations on environment initialization and in-context examples. Further analysis identifies difficulties in both exploration and the use of past observations. The evaluated VLA models struggle to reach anomalies in large 3D worlds, limiting the evidence available for subsequent analysis. For VLM agents, the memory tool that lets them store and retrieve observations during exploration substantially improves anomaly discovery. These findings suggest that world auditing benefits from both exploration guided by ongoing analysis and access to evidence gathered earlier in the trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 为了更好地理解这一差距，我们评估了五种模型主干，并对环境初始化和上下文示例进行了受控的消融分析。 进一步的分析发现，探索过程以及对过往观察结果的使用都存在困难。 所评估的 VLA 模型难以在大型三维世界中定位异常，这限制了后续分析可用证据的数量。 对于 VLM 智能体而言，允许它们在探索过程中存储和检索观察结果的记忆工具，显著提升了异常发现能力。 这些发现表明，世界审计既受益于持续分析所引导的探索，也受益于对轨迹早期阶段收集到的证据的访问。

paragraphs.en: Visual Understanding and Anomaly Detection. Existing works mainly evaluate agents’ multimodal abilities using static visual assets. For example, Video-MME focuses on prerecorded videos ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , while VideoGameBunny studies game video clips ( Taesiri & Bezemer, 2025 ) . GlitchBench, VideoGameQA-Bench, and VideoGlitchBench further evaluate glitch recognition, localization, description, and reporting from images or videos ( Taesiri et al., 2024 ; Taesiri et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) . However, these benchmarks provide observations to the model in advance and mainly test whether agents can answer questions reliably based on available visual evidence. In contrast, our work focuses on the more challenging setting of interactive world auditing, where agents must actively gather the evidence needed to expose and verify anomalies.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉理解与异常检测。 现有研究主要通过静态视觉素材来评估智能体的多模态能力。 例如，Video-MME 关注预录视频（Fu et al., 2025），而 VideoGameBunny 则研究游戏视频片段（Taesiri & Bezemer, 2025）。 GlitchBench、VideoGameQA-Bench 和 VideoGlitchBench 进一步评估了从图像或视频中识别、定位、描述和报告异常的能力（Taesiri et al., 2024；Taesiri et al., 2025；Zheng et al., 2026）。 然而，这些基准测试会提前向模型提供观察信息，主要测试智能体能否基于现有的视觉证据可靠地回答问题。 相比之下，我们的研究更关注更具挑战性的交互式世界审计场景，其中智能体必须主动收集揭露和验证异常所需的证据。

paragraphs.en: Interactive Embodied Reasoning and Anomaly Search. Existing works also evaluate agents’ embodied abilities in interactive environments. For example, AI2-THOR ( Kolve et al., 2017 ) , Habitat ( Savva et al., 2019 ) , UnrealCV ( Qiu & Yuille, 2016 ) , SimWorld ( Ren et al., 2025 ) , and UnrealZoo ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) provide 3D environments for embodied perception and interaction, while EmbodiedBench ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , VisualAgentBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , and OpenEQA ( Majumdar et al., 2024 ) evaluate agents on interactive task execution and information gathering. More closely related to our work, FlySearch ( Pardyl et al., 2025 ) includes an anomaly-search task that requires agents to locate out-of-place objects in 3D environments. However, they mainly focus on task completion or locating visually identifiable anomalies. In contrast, our work studies anomalies that may require agents to actively test physical properties or compare observations across viewpoints and time, making evidence gathering itself an essential part of anomaly identification.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式具身推理与异常搜索。 现有研究也评估了智能体在交互式环境中的具身能力。 例如，AI2-THOR（Kolve 等人，2017）、Habitat（Savva 等人，2019）、UnrealCV（Qiu & Yuille，2016）、SimWorld（Ren 等人，2025）和 UnrealZoo（Zhong 等人，2025）为具身感知与交互提供了三维环境，而 EmbodiedBench（Yang 等人，2025a）、VisualAgentBench（Liu 等人，2024）和 OpenEQA（Majumdar 等人，2024）则评估智能体在执行交互式任务和收集信息方面的能力。 与我们的工作更为相关的是，FlySearch（Pardyl 等人，2025）包含一个异常搜索任务，要求智能体在三维环境中定位不合常理的对象。 然而，这些研究主要关注任务完成或定位通过视觉即可识别的异常。 相比之下，我们的工作研究了可能需要智能体主动测试物理属性，或在不同视角和时间点比较观察结果的异常，这使得证据收集本身成为异常识别的关键环节。

sents.en: Our anomaly taxonomy draws on game-bug studies that distinguish failures visible in a single state from those requiring observations over time ( Lewis et al., 2010 ) , and describe failures in object position, collision, rendering, persistence, and state transitions ( Truelove et al., 2021 ; Butt et al., 2023 ) .

sents.en: We group anomalies by their observable effects into five families (Figure 1 ):
sents.zh: 我们根据异常的可观察影响，将其分为五类（图 1）：

paragraphs.en: Static physics: Anomalies in which static objects disobey physics, involving object support, overlap, or scale;
paragraphs.zh: 静态物理：静态物体违反物理规律的异常现象，涉及物体的支撑、重叠或缩放问题；

paragraphs.en: Interactive physics: Anomalies in which interactions between objects or between the agent and the environment disobey physics, involving obstruction and objects’ responses to contact;
paragraphs.zh: 交互式物理：物体之间或智能体与环境之间的相互作用违背物理规律的异常现象，包括阻碍以及物体对接触的反应；

paragraphs.en: Spatial consistency: Anomalies in which objects are inconsistent across positions or viewpoints, such as appearance changes in an object as the observer moves;
paragraphs.zh: 空间一致性：物体在不同位置或视角之间不一致的异常现象，例如观察者在移动时物体外观发生变化；

paragraphs.en: Temporal consistency: Anomalies in which objects display unexpected changes over time, such as changes in existence, attributes, and behavior;
paragraphs.zh: 时间一致性：物体随时间出现意外变化的异常现象，例如存在、属性和行为的改变；

paragraphs.en: Semantic consistency: Anomalies in which object configurations are inconsistent with the semantic context, involving the intended functionality of the object and historical context.
paragraphs.zh: 语义一致性：指物体配置与语义背景不一致的异常情况，涉及物体的预期功能及历史背景。

paragraphs.en: The five families of anomaly are further divided into fifteen categories. Appendix C.5 provides full definitions of each category and some examples. Anomaly families differ in the evidence required to detect them: some are visible in a single view, such as those in the static physics family, while others can only be exposed through deliberate actions, such as interacting with objects, changing viewpoints, or revisiting a location after a period of time. Together, these families form a comprehensive test of planning, memory, and scene understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 异常的五大家族进一步细分为十五个类别。 附录 C.5 提供了每个类别的完整定义和一些示例。 不同异常家族在检测所需的证据上存在差异：有些异常在单个视角下即可显现，例如静态物理家族中的异常；而另一些则只能通过特定操作才能暴露出来，例如与物体互动、改变视角，或在一段时间后再返回某个地点。 这些家族共同构成了一项对规划能力、记忆能力和场景理解能力的全面测试。

paragraphs.en: To construct tasks based on the aforementioned taxonomy, we follow three steps: scene collection, task construction, and human validation (Figure 2 ).

paragraphs.en: Scene Collection. We collect 13 interactive 3D environments built with Unreal Engine 5 and Three.js from publicly available sources, covering indoor, urban, historical, industrial, and natural settings. These environments range from furnished rooms and urban streets to historical markets and outdoor landscapes. For larger environments, we manually select several bounded regions as individual scenes, seeking distinct spatial layouts and scene content, yielding 27 scenes in total. Appendix A presents the environments and representative views.
paragraphs.zh: 场景收集。 我们从公开来源收集了 13 个使用 Unreal Engine 5 和 Three.js 构建的交互式 3D 环境，涵盖室内、城市、历史、工业和自然场景。 这些环境包括带家具的房间和城市街道，也涵盖历史市场和户外景观。 对于较大的环境，我们手动选择几个有边界的区域作为独立场景，力求获得不同的空间布局和场景内容，最终共得到 27 个场景。 附录 A 展示了这些环境及其代表性视图。

paragraphs.en: Task Construction. All tasks are hand-crafted by the authors. To construct a task, we first select a bug-free scene, where we further define permissible regions for exploration, the starting position and orientation of the agent, and available interactions. Based on the taxonomy, we then introduce an anomaly by perturbing the scene, such as changing object placement, collision, appearance, responses to interaction, or behavior over time. For semantic anomalies, we rearrange objects in ways that conflict with their intended function or add objects that do not fit the scene’s historical setting. Appendix B.1 details the construction procedure. Each task is annotated with the ground-truth anomaly category along with an evaluation rubric describing the target anomaly and its expected normal appearance or behavior. Appendix B.2 presents an example.
paragraphs.zh: 任务构建。 所有任务均由作者手工设计。 要构建一个任务，我们首先选择一个无错误的场景，并在其中进一步定义允许探索的区域、智能体的起始位置和朝向，以及可用的交互方式。 基于该分类体系，我们通过扰动场景引入异常，例如改变物体位置、碰撞、外观、对交互的响应或随时间的行为变化。 对于语义异常，我们会以违背其预期功能的方式重新排列物体，或添加与场景历史设定不符的物体。 附录 B.1 详细说明了构建流程。 每个任务都标注了真实异常的类别，并附有一份评估标准，用于描述目标异常及其预期的正常外观或行为。 附录 B.2 提供了一个示例。

sents.en: Based on the taxonomy, we then introduce an anomaly by perturbing the scene, such as changing object placement, collision, appearance, responses to interaction, or behavior over time.
sents.zh: 基于该分类体系，我们通过扰动场景引入异常，例如改变物体位置、碰撞、外观、对交互的响应或随时间的行为变化。

sents.en: For semantic anomalies, we rearrange objects in ways that conflict with their intended function or add objects that do not fit the scene’s historical setting.
sents.zh: 对于语义异常，我们会以违背其预期功能的方式重新排列物体，或添加与场景历史设定不符的物体。

sents.zh: 附录 B.1 详细说明了构建流程。

sents.en: Each task is annotated with the ground-truth anomaly category along with an evaluation rubric describing the target anomaly and its expected normal appearance or behavior.
sents.zh: 每个任务都标注了真实异常的类别，并附有一份评估标准，用于描述目标异常及其预期的正常外观或行为。

paragraphs.en: Human Validation. To verify task quality, judges who did not participate in the task construction process, are asked to explore the scene in each task to check whether the target anomaly can be observed and verified and whether it matches the annotations. They rate task quality as Pass, Fail, or Uncertain. Fail or Uncertain judgments lead to further revision and review. This process repeats until the task meets the acceptance requirement: Rated Pass by at least two judges on the same task version . Appendix B.3 describes the review protocol and annotation interface.
paragraphs.zh: 人类验证。 为了验证任务质量，要求未参与任务构建流程的评审员探索每个任务中的场景，检查目标异常现象是否可观察且可验证，以及是否与标注内容一致。 他们对任务质量进行“通过”“失败”或“不确定”的评级。 “失败”或“不确定”的判断会引发进一步的修订与复审。 此过程将持续重复，直到任务满足验收要求：同一任务版本至少获得两名评审员的“通过”评级。 附录 B.3 介绍了复审流程与标注界面。

paragraphs.en: To study how the coupling of action and visual reasoning affects 3D world auditing, we evaluate two paradigms: VLM-only and VLA–VLM (Figure 3 ). We first define the task for the auditing agent in Section 4.1 , and then describe these two paradigms in Sections 4.2 and 4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究动作与视觉推理的耦合如何影响三维世界审计，我们评估了两种范式：仅使用 VLM 的范式和 VLA–VLM 范式（图 3）。 我们在第 4.1 节中首先定义了审计智能体的任务，然后在第 4.2 节和第 4.3 节中描述了这两种范式。

sents.en: To study how the coupling of action and visual reasoning affects 3D world auditing, we evaluate two paradigms: VLM-only and VLA–VLM (Figure 3 ).
sents.zh: 为了研究动作与视觉推理的耦合如何影响三维世界审计，我们评估了两种范式：仅使用 VLM 的范式和 VLA–VLM 范式（图 3）。

sents.en: We first define the task for the auditing agent in Section 4.1 , and then describe these two paradigms in Sections 4.2 and 4.3 .
sents.zh: 我们在第 4.1 节中首先定义了审计智能体的任务，然后在第 4.2 节和第 4.3 节中描述了这两种范式。

paragraphs.en: At the start of a task, the auditor receives an initial input x x containing auditing instructions, task context, and an initial observation. The task context includes a scene description, an anomaly-type hint, and a matching in-context example. The initial observation is the first-person RGB view from the starting pose. From this input, the auditor explores the environment under a fixed budget and produces a final anomaly report containing the identified anomaly and supporting observation images during its exploration and interaction within the 3D world. Each task in the main evaluation contains only one target anomaly, and success is determined by whether the report identifies it. In both paradigms, the agent submits an anomaly report and evidence to the VLM judge, which evaluates them against the task’s evaluation rubric, such as identifying a solid wall that the agent can pass through. Appendices C.3 and C.4 illustrate an example report and its evaluation process.
paragraphs.zh: 任务开始时，审计员会收到一个初始输入 x，其中包含审计指令、任务上下文以及一个初始观察结果。 任务上下文包括场景描述、异常类型提示以及一个匹配的上下文示例。 初始观察结果是来自起始姿态的第一人称 RGB 视角。 基于此输入，审计员会在固定预算下探索环境，并最终生成一份异常报告，其中包含已识别的异常以及在 3D 世界中探索和交互期间获得的辅助观察图像。 主评估中的每个任务仅包含一个目标异常，成功与否取决于报告是否识别出该异常。 在这两种范式下，智能体都会向 VLM 裁判提交一份异常报告和证据，裁判会根据任务的评估标准对其进行评估，例如识别出智能体可以穿过的实心墙。 附录 C.3 和 C.4 展示了一份示例报告及其评估过程。

paragraphs.en: The VLA–VLM paradigm separates exploration from anomaly analysis (Figure 3 (b)). A VLA model first generates environment actions a t a_{t} and collects a trajectory of observations. Due to the limitations of existing VLA models, no explicit reasoning is produced during exploration. A VLM then analyzes the recorded observations together with the task context to identify anomalies and produce a report with supporting evidence. In our experiments, we use fixed recorded trajectories recorded by the same VLA model for second-stage analysis, which is conducted by different VLM backbones. Because the VLM analyzes the trajectory only after exploration is complete, its intermediate observations cannot guide further actions to investigate potential anomalies, which may limit its auditing performance.
paragraphs.zh: VLA–VLM 范式将探索与异常分析分离（图 3 (b)）。 VLA 模型首先生成环境动作 a t a_{t}，并收集观察序列。 由于现有 VLA 模型的局限性，在探索过程中不会产生明确的推理过程。 随后，VLM 会结合任务上下文分析已记录的观察数据，以识别异常并生成包含支持证据的报告。 在我们的实验中，我们使用由同一 VLA 模型记录下来的固定轨迹进行第二阶段分析，而该分析则由不同的 VLM 主干模型执行。 由于 VLM 仅在探索完成后才开始分析轨迹，其中间观察结果无法指导后续动作以调查潜在的异常，这可能会限制其审计性能。

paragraphs.en: Agent Implementation. We evaluate GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Muse Spark 1.3, and Qwen 3.8 Flash under the two auditing paradigms in Section 4 . We run GPT-6 Astra with Codex CLI ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , Gemini 3.8 Flash with Gemini CLI ( Google, 2026 ) , Muse Spark 1.3 with OpenCode ( Anomaly, 2026 ) , and Qwen 3.8 Flash with Qwen Code ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . These harnesses manage model calls and conversation history, while a shared Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface ( Model Context Protocol, 2025 ) exposes the auditing tools in Table 6 . Each comparison thus evaluates a model together with its harness. In the VLM-only paradigm, VLM auditors receive a budget of 40 environment actions. In the VLA–VLM paradigm, we use Open-P2P 1.2B ( Yue et al., 2026 ) as the VLA model to collect 60 seconds of simulated exploration, with observations sampled every 0.5 seconds. Recorded trajectories are shared across VLM backbones; the two paradigms use different exploration budgets.

paragraphs.en: Human Baseline. Besides AI agents, we evaluate human performance on this task. Our human evaluation involves approximately ten computer science PhD students. Each task is evaluated by two participants. Participants receive the same task information as the models, including the scene description, auditing instructions, and in-context examples (Appendix C.1 ). They have up to ten minutes per task to explore the environment and report their findings. Human reports are evaluated by the same VLM judge against the same evaluation rubrics as model reports.
paragraphs.zh: 人类基准。 除了 AI 智能体，我们还评估了人类在此任务上的表现。 我们的人类评估涉及大约十名计算机科学领域的博士生。 每个任务都由两名参与者进行评估。 参与者获得与模型相同的任务信息，包括场景描述、审核说明和上下文示例（附录 C.1）。 他们每个任务最多有十分钟的时间来探索环境并报告他们的发现。 人类的报告由相同的 VLM 评判者依据与模型报告相同的评估标准进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 shows that auditing remains challenging across five backbones. Spatial and temporal consistency require comparing observations across viewpoints or time, and receive lower scores. Temporal consistency is particularly challenging, with SR at or below 12.5% for every model and paradigm. paragraphs.en: Most models achieve higher SR with interactive VLM auditing than with VLA–VLM analysis of fixed trajectories. Interactive auditors can choose additional viewpoints and actions as they reason, whereas VLA–VLM auditors analyze fixed trajectories. paragraphs.en: We study how starting distance, exploration budget, and task guidance affect auditing with Gemini 3.8 Flash on 126 Unreal tasks (Table 3 ).

paragraphs.en: Starting Distance. We move the starting position closer to the target anomaly, reducing the navigable route distance to approximately one third of its original length while keeping the agent’s initial orientation unchanged. Moving closer increases the VLM-only success rate from 33.3% to 38.1% and the VLA–VLM success rate from 5.6% to 7.1%. These results indicate that auditing becomes more challenging when agents start farther from the anomaly.

paragraphs.en: To test auditing with coexisting anomalies, we select 21 anchor tasks, three from each of seven Unreal Engine 5 environments, and evaluate the Gemini 3.8 Flash VLM auditor with a 40-step budget. The original anomaly is called the anchor anomaly . For each anchor, we randomly introduce one or two additional anomalies on distinct objects to form two- and three-anomaly conditions, sampling two configurations per anchor for each condition, yielding 42 runs per condition. Agents are given the total number of anomalies, but only the anchor anomaly’s type and in-context example. We report the success rate in identifying the anchor anomaly (anchor SR), the success rate in identifying every anomaly (all-anomaly SR), and the fraction of anomalies identified (target recall).
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试在共存异常情况下的审计能力，我们选择了 21 个锚任务，每个 Unreal Engine 5 环境（共 7 个）中选取 3 个任务，并使用 40 步预算来评估 Gemini 3.8 Flash VLM 审计器。 原始异常被称为锚异常。 对于每个锚任务，我们在不同对象上随机引入一个或两个额外异常，以形成包含两种和三种异常的情况；每种情况为每个锚任务采样两种配置，从而得到每种情况下的 42 次运行。 智能体被告知异常的总数，但仅能获得锚异常的类型和上下文示例。 我们报告了识别锚异常的成功率（锚成功率）、识别所有异常的成功率（全异常成功率），以及被识别出的异常所占比例（目标召回率）。

paragraphs.en: As discussed in Section 4 , VLM auditing couples action with visual reasoning. Using GPT-6 Astra on 213 tasks, we examine two aspects of its advantage over VLA–VLM auditing: ❶ anomaly exposure , whether exploration reveals the anomaly, and ❷ anomaly identification upon exposure , whether the agent identifies the anomaly once it is revealed. We assess exposure using geometric coverage, based on the agent’s position and orientation, and human-rated exposure, based on exploration videos. For identification, we compare success rates on exposed tasks under both measures.
paragraphs.zh: 如第 4 节所述，VLM 审计将行动与视觉推理相结合。 通过在 213 项任务上使用 GPT-6 Astra，我们考察了其相对于 VLA–VLM 审计的两个优势方面：❶ 异常暴露，即探索是否能揭示异常；以及 ❷ 暴露后的异常识别，即智能体在异常被揭示后能否识别出该异常。 我们通过几何覆盖度（基于智能体的位置和朝向）以及人类评分的暴露度（基于探索视频）来评估暴露情况。 对于识别能力，我们比较了两种衡量标准下，智能体在完成已暴露任务时的成功率。

paragraphs.en: Anomaly Exposure. Geometric coverage is 91.1% for the VLM agent and 47.4% for the VLA explorer, while human-rated exposure is 68.1% and 34.7%, respectively (Figure 6 ). For spatial and temporal consistency anomalies, human-rated exposure requires contrasting viewpoints or before-and-after states, whereas geometric coverage requires only one qualifying frame. The higher exposure of the VLM agent suggests that reasoning and planning help direct exploration toward relevant parts of the scene. Given in-context examples, the VLM agent can reason about what an anomaly may look like, plan actions to investigate likely locations, and update its plan based on new observations. The VLA–VLM paradigm separates exploration from anomaly analysis, preventing this feedback from guiding the VLA’s actions.

paragraphs.en: Recognition With Tools And Memory. On the tasks geometrically covered by both paradigms, the VLM agent achieves 38.5% success, versus 26.0% for the VLA–VLM auditor; on the tasks with human-rated exposure, the gap is consistent (62.1% versus 47.3%). The advantage of the VLM-only paradigm thus extends beyond reaching anomaly locations. The VLM agent can inspect additional viewpoints, test suspected anomalies through interaction, and use memory tools to retrieve earlier frames and notes. This access to long-term evidence supports comparisons across viewpoints and time, helping the agent recognize inconsistencies that are difficult to establish from an isolated observation. In contrast, the two-stage auditor relies on the evidence present in its recorded trajectory. Effective auditing therefore benefits from both exploration and the ability to gather and connect evidence during recognition.
paragraphs.zh: 借助工具与记忆进行识别。 在两种范式共同覆盖的几何任务中，VLM 智能体的成功率为 38.5%，而 VLA–VLM 审计器为 26.0%；在经人类评估暴露度的任务中，这一差距保持一致（62.1% 对比 47.3%）。 因此，仅使用 VLM 的范式所带来的优势不仅体现在能够定位异常位置。 VLM 智能体可以检查更多视角，通过交互测试可疑的异常，并利用记忆工具检索先前的帧和笔记。 这种对长期证据的访问支持跨视角和跨时间的比较，帮助智能体识别仅凭孤立观察难以确定的不一致之处。 相比之下，两阶段审计器只能依赖其记录轨迹中已有的证据。 因此，有效的审计既需要探索能力，也需要在识别过程中收集并关联证据的能力。

paragraphs.en: We introduced WorldAuditBench, a benchmark of 213 tasks across 13 environments and five anomaly families for studying how multimodal agents couple action and visual reasoning in interactive 3D worlds. VLM-only auditors generally outperform VLA–VLM auditors, yet both remain far below human performance. Our analysis separates failures to expose anomalies from failures to identify them after exposure; reduced task guidance and coexisting anomalies further challenge discovery. These findings highlight the challenge of deciding which observations to seek and whether they support a conclusion. WorldAuditBench provides a testbed for agents that form hypotheses from observations, test them through action, and connect evidence across viewpoints and time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 WorldAuditBench，这是一个包含 13 个环境和 5 类异常、共 213 项任务的基准测试，用于研究多模态智能体如何在交互式 3D 世界中将动作与视觉推理相结合。 仅使用 VLM 的审计器通常表现优于同时使用 VLA 和 VLM 的审计器，但两者都远不及人类的表现。 我们的分析将未能揭示异常的情况与在揭示后未能识别异常的情况区分开来；任务指导的减少以及异常的同时存在进一步增加了发现异常的难度。 这些发现凸显了决定应寻求哪些观察结果以及这些结果是否支持某一结论所面临的挑战。 WorldAuditBench 为那些能从观察中形成假设、通过行动进行验证，并在不同视角和时间点之间关联证据的智能体提供了一个测试平台。

paragraphs.en: For each task, the authors start from a configuration without the target anomaly and specify the agent’s initial position and orientation, exploration boundaries, and available interactions. They then introduce one anomaly from the taxonomy in Section 3.2 . Static physics anomalies alter object support, overlap, or scale; interactive physics anomalies alter collision or responses to contact. Spatial consistency anomalies change appearance across viewpoints, visibility, or lighting, while temporal consistency anomalies change an object’s existence, attributes, or behavior over time. Semantic consistency anomalies involve improper object configurations or objects incompatible with the scene’s historical setting.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，作者们从一个没有目标异常的配置开始，并指定智能体的初始位置和方向、探索边界以及可用交互。 然后，他们引入第 3.2 节分类体系中的一个异常。 静态物理异常会改变物体的支撑、重叠或尺度；交互式物理异常则会改变碰撞或对接触的反应。 空间一致性异常会改变不同视角下的外观、可见性或光照，而时间一致性异常则会改变物体随时间的存在、属性或行为。 语义一致性异常涉及不正确的物体配置或与场景历史设定不兼容的物体。

paragraphs.en: Reviewers assign a quality judgment of Pass, Fail, or Uncertain. Pass indicates that the target anomaly is observable and matches its rubric; Fail or Uncertain prompts further revision and review. They also rate identification difficulty as Easy, Medium, or Hard and can leave comments to describe ambiguous behavior or problems with the task. These ratings assess dataset quality and are separate from the human auditing baseline in Section 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 评审员会给出“通过”、“失败”或“不确定”的质量判断。 “通过”表示目标异常现象可被观察到且符合其评分标准；“失败”或“不确定”则提示需要进一步修改和评审。 他们还会将识别难度评定为“简单”、“中等”或“困难”，并可以留下评论来描述模糊的行为或任务中的问题。 这些评级用于评估数据集的质量，并且与第 5 节中的人类审计基准无关。

paragraphs.en: The authors revise tasks and rubrics based on reviewer feedback and submit them for another round of validation. paragraphs.en: To assess the reliability of the VLM judge, we compared its binary decisions with human evaluations of human-baseline reports across Unreal Engine and Three.js environments, where a separate human evaluator gives binary decision to human baseline’s results on bug auditing task with same rubric and instruction as the GPT-6 Astra VLM judge. Each GPT-6 Astra decision uses the corresponding evaluation rubric and cited screenshots, without access to human judgments. As shown in Table 7 , the judge achieved high overall agreement with human judgments, with comparable agreement across the two engine types: Unreal Engine and Three.js. These findings support cross-environment consistency under the evaluation protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 VLM 判断器的可靠性，我们将它在 Unreal Engine 和 Three.js 环境中对人类基准报告所做的二元决策与人类的评估结果进行了比较；其中，一名独立的人类评估者使用与 GPT-6 Astra VLM 判断器相同的评分标准和说明，对人类基准在漏洞审计任务中的结果做出二元决策。 每个 GPT-6 Astra 的决策都使用了相应的评估评分标准和引用的截图，但没有访问人类判断结果的权限。 如表 7 所示，该判断器与人类判断的整体一致性很高，并且在 Unreal Engine 和 Three.js 这两种引擎类型中的一致性相当。 这些发现支持了该评估协议在不同环境下的稳定性。
